result.title: Wide View Synthesis from Overlapping Perspective Cameras in Autonomous Driving
result.summary: Multi-perspective-camera systems are widely adopted since they provide broad visual coverage for autonomous driving, motivating the synthesis of a unified wide view from spatially separated observations. In this work, we formulate wide view synthesis (WVS), which aims to synthesize a geometrically consistent wide view at a specified virtual viewpoint from multiple perspective cameras. Unlike conventional image stitching, WVS requires reasoning about 3D geometry and visibility to handle depth-dependent parallax and occlusions arising from spatially separated camera centers. While vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity view synthesis, its reliance on per-scene optimization limits its applicability to driving scenes. Furthermore, WVS introduces additional challenges, *e.g.*, peripheral stretching under perspective projection and photometric inconsistencies across cameras. To address these challenges, we propose **Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS)**, a feed-forward Gaussian-splatting framework that synthesizes wide views without per-scene optimization. Specifically, we introduce Piecewise Perspective Rendering (PPR) to mitigate peripheral stretching through local perspective projections sharing a common camera center, and Spatial Affine Photometric Modeling (SAPM) to account for camera-dependent photometric variations during training. We further introduce **WideDrive**, a synthetic benchmark providing dense ground-truth wide views and adapt a LiDAR-projected sparse-reference protocol to real-world datasets. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of WV-GS for WVS. Dataset and code will be publicly released.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作定义「宽视角合成」任务，用前馈 Gaussian Splatting 从多个分离的环视相机合成统一宽视角图像，并提出分片透视渲染与跨相机光度建模以缓解边缘拉伸和亮度不一致，同时构建 WideDrive 合成基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯合成渲染任务、不涉及推理状态或停止决策，但其前馈式多视角几何融合与可见性/遮挡建模，可能为 LVR 中跨视角视觉证据的几何一致性聚合与筛选提供可供核查的表征线索。
